title: [searchBox] manually focus on load when there's no query
body:
The current `searchBox` behavior is to add `autofocus="autofocus"` to the generated or inplace searchBox.

This cannot always work because `autofocus` attribute works if you are before DOMReady/load I guess.

There's currently a bug where there is sometimes autofocus, sometimes not.

In the end here's what we should do:

* manually focus the searchBox if there's no query defined (empty query)
* do not do anything if there's already a query, most of the time it looks weird to autofocus in this case
* add an autofocus: true/false option to the searchBox (since the user cannot disable autofocus with autofocus=off now)
